tradeIdeas.title: iTraxx Asia IG CDS Protection - Reload; Compression Thesis Reversed
tradeIdeas.rationale: iTraxx Asia IG ~138bp (Aug 5 est.) remains carried and well above the Jun 22-23 compression zone. Renewed US-Iran strikes and tanker incidents have increased the risk that the conditional Iran-Oman traffic plan fails; no signed reopening is verified. Maintain protection at 60-70%. Stress (55%): iTraxx returns to 150-180bp if talks stall. Tail (40%): spikes to 200-230bp if strikes resume at scale. Only reduce on a confirmed reopening with sustained traffic normalisation.
instruments: Sapura Energy / Hyflux bond short via CDS (maintain)

tradeIdeas.title: JKM-TTF Spread - Stop Out; Europe Outbids Asia for Gulf Cargoes
tradeIdeas.rationale: TTF 66.56 EUR/MWh (Yahoo Finance, Aug 28; carried) while official JKM remains $22.00/MMBtu carried (Reuters, Jul 24); the contextual JKM CFD reference rose to $23.62/MMBtu on Sep 1 (Trading Economics). The Iran-Oman traffic plan remains conditional and QatarEnergy force majeure is now reported into early November. Keep the long-JKM/short-TTF thesis closed; a confirmed reopening would compress both markers, while renewed disruption would re-widen the spread.
instruments: Asia LNG spot cargo purchase via intermediary (hold off)

tradeIdeas.title: Close ASEAN Banks Long / Hold Energy Underweight - Compression Trade Invalidated
tradeIdeas.rationale: iTraxx Asia IG ~138bp (Aug 5 est.) is carried, while ASEAN Banks ~207.5 idx and ASEAN Energy ~116 remain estimates. Brent settled at $94.65 on Sep 1, up 4.6% (Reuters via MarketScreener), as renewed strikes and tanker incidents weakened the compression thesis. Hold the energy underweight; close the banks long only when reopening is confirmed and credit spreads show sustained compression. Tail probability is now 40%.
instruments: ASEAN Banks ETF (hold neutral, no long)

tradeIdeas.title: Maintain Long USD/PHP and USD/IDR - Pause Is Tactical, Not Structural
tradeIdeas.rationale: USD/PHP ~55.5 and USD/IDR ~15,750 remain Aug 5 estimates. The relief should not reverse positions: AP reported renewed US-Iran strikes and UKMTO-reported tanker incidents on Sep 1, while no final deal or signed commercial reopening is verified. Brent settled at $94.65 (Reuters via MarketScreener, Sep 1; +4.6%) and remains above pre-crisis levels. Maintain short PHP/IDR (long USD); re-enter long PHP/IDR only on confirmed reopening with sustained traffic normalisation. Tail probability is 40%.
instruments: ASEAN EM FX basket (maintain short vs USD)
